metadata.audit_name: HVA-04 Phase 1 Minimal Prototype Contract Audit
metadata.mode: READ-ONLY CONTRACT AUDIT / NO CODE / NO IMPLEMENTATION / FROZEN INTACT / STOP
metadata.scope: Phase 1 Minimal Prototype Contract Audit (P4 + P6 + P7 + Counterexample Search)

executive_summary.minimal_prototype: C (FeedbackRecord + Evidence Pack + Evidence Signature + SignalCandidate)
executive_summary.key_finding: Phase 1 is NOT ready for implementation. 4 contract gaps identified. GAP-1 (content_type) and GAP-4 (L5 vs machine_eval TLD inconsistency) must be resolved before code. GAP-2 (P2 geometry) resolved by dropping L2. GAP-3 (P7 lacks TLD) documented as limitation.

GAP-1.description: content_type field does not exist in ANY data file
GAP-1.actual_source: Manually derived in HVA-01 case profiles
GAP-1.resolution: Define derivation rule: is_in_table+is01_a→TABLE_NUMERIC, is_in_table+!is01_a→TABLE_TEXT, !is_in_table+period→PROSE, text starts with Fig→FIGURE
GAP-1.status: DERIVABLE but rule must be documented before implementation

GAP-2.description: P2 geometry fields (h_gap, dy, same_style, width_a/b, style_sig_a/b) exist ONLY in L5 experiment_cases, NOT in IS-11 machine_eval
GAP-2.resolution: Drop L2 from Phase 1. Use L0-L1 only.

GAP-3.description: P7 has NO TLD fields (is_in_table, different_cell) — 0/69 cases
GAP-3.actual_source: P7 machine_results has decision_evidence (is01_a, is02_b) but no TLD
GAP-3.resolution: Document as known limitation. P7 can match on 4 fields (is01_a, is02_b, period, capital) but NOT on is_in_table/different_cell. SIG-01 counterexample search is PARTIAL on P7. SIG-02 counterexample search is FULL on P7.

GAP-4.description: L5 experiment has_tld=False for 9/30 cases where machine_eval HAS TLD data. L5 cues show TLD=None but machine_eval is11_observation has TLD results.
GAP-4.actual_source: L5 experiment_cases cues vs machine_eval is11_observation
GAP-4.evidence: AMB-032: L5 has_tld=False, cues TLD=None; machine_eval is_in_table=True, different_cell=True
GAP-4.resolution: Evidence Pack MUST read TLD data from machine_eval (is11_observation), NOT from L5 experiment_cases (cues). L5 cues are experiment presentation, not ground truth.
GAP-4.severity: HIGH (data source decision critical for correctness)

p6_feedbackrecord_audit.rationale_reason: L5 data: 96% no expansion, 91% GT rationales formulaic. Rationale not reliable signal source. Machine constructs Signal from Decision + Evidence Context, not from rationale.
p6_feedbackrecord_audit.contract_status: READY — all required fields available from existing data

evidence_signature_audit.definition: Structural fingerprint = dict of boolean/enum fields from evidence_snapshot. NOT semantic label, NOT rule, NOT embedding, NOT confidence, NOT text matching.

semantic_boundary_check.same_signature_different_semantics: YES — AMB-375 (KS) and P7 IND-AMB-049 (MERGE) have same signature but different decisions. Signature does NOT resolve semantic ambiguity. Human does.
semantic_boundary_check.conclusion: Evidence Signature does NOT cross Semantic Boundary.

evidence_signature_audit.contract_status: GAP (GAP-1 content_type derivation needed; GAP-3 P7 lacks TLD fields for full match)

state_machine.INDEPENDENCE_VERIFIED: independence check passed (≥2 independent doc-page groups)
state_machine.BOUNDARY_REVIEW_REQUIRED: counterexamples found OR ceiling effect → MUST go to Human (Phase 2)

candidate_not_rule_check.conclusion: Candidate = "Here are N cases with similar evidence and similar decisions." NOT "When you see this evidence, decide this way."

counterexample_search_audit.search_method: Exact boolean match on Evidence Signature fields. NO model/LLM/embedding needed.
counterexample_search_audit.contract_status: GAP (GAP-3: P7 lacks TLD → PARTIAL match for SIG-01 type signals. FULL match for SIG-02 type signals.)
counterexample_search_audit.phase1_scope: DEFERRED to Phase 1.5 (not in minimal prototype C)

ceiling_effect_audit.safest_state: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (clearer than CEILING_EFFECT — prevents misinterpretation as positive validation)
ceiling_effect_audit.phase1_handling: ceiling cases stop at BOUNDARY_REVIEW_REQUIRED. No VALIDATED state reachable in Phase 1.

authority_check.conclusion: Case Selection = SAMPLING (structural), not JUDGING (semantic). NO new Selection Authority.

human_boundary_audit.conclusion: NO Machine output substitutes Human Semantic Judgment. Human retains sole authority over decisions.

minimal_prototype_selection.rationale: Core hypothesis = "Human feedback can be linked to Evidence and grouped by structural similarity into Signal Candidates." C proves this minimal closed loop. Counterexample Search (D) proves safety, not core hypothesis. Defer to Phase 1.5.
minimal_prototype_selection.principle: Choose minimal closed loop that proves core hypothesis, not most feature-complete version.

implementation_blockers: GAP-1: content_type derivation rule must be documented before implementation
GAP-4: Evidence Pack must read TLD from machine_eval (is11_observation), NOT from L5 experiment_cases (cues) — data source decision
Case Selection guardrails must be labeled as "sampling_guardrail" not "hard_rule"
